items.title: Are stablecoins and bank deposits substitutes?
items.desc: We test whether stablecoins and bank deposits act as substitutes by estimating the semi-elasticity of stablecoin market capitalization with respect to deposit rate changes. Using local projections fit to weekly U.S. data from January 2019 to June 2025, we find that deposit rate increases predict slower stablecoin growth. To address endogeneity, we exploit a nonlinearity in deposit rate pass-through. Whereas other money market rates track the federal funds rate roughly linearly, banksreprice deposits more aggressively once it exceeds approximately 3%.
